+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Decision-ledger tooling: the cross-batch decision queue as a parseable ledger.
+
+This module is the machine half of the D8 decision system (proposal §4.2, G7-AC-01..05).
+The ledger lives at ``docs/PENDING-DECISIONS.md`` and follows the "只追加、永不移出"
+rule: a decision, once recorded as ``DEC-YYYY-NNN``, is never removed. It advances by
+revision (``r1``, ``r2`` …), a revision may be withdrawn, and the current revision may
+declare ``equivalent_to`` an earlier one so downstream pins do not go stale on a
+text-only change.
+
+Three subcommands:
+
+* ``view``        — render the *pending* view (only still-active decisions), replacing the
+                    old manual row-carry where resolved rows were lifted out by hand.
+* ``check``       — scan every downstream document's ``decision_deps`` frontmatter, compute
+                    the reverse index, and report only the documents truly affected by a
+                    decision revision. Pinning a withdrawn revision is red; pinning an
+                    ``equivalent_to`` revision stays green; an affected doc may register a
+                    ``stale_reason`` + ``review_date`` to stay green; pinning only an
+                    invariant stays green while the invariant still holds.
+* ``index --write`` — regenerate ``docs/decisions/index.md`` (a generated file; hand-edits
+                      are caught by the gate's digest assertion).
+
+The module is standard-library only so the gate can import it without side effects.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import re
+import sys
+from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+PENDING_DECISIONS = ROOT / "docs" / "PENDING-DECISIONS.md"
+DECISIONS_INDEX = ROOT / "docs" / "decisions" / "index.md"
+
+# Columns the decision-record table must carry (mirrors docchain C16's DECISION_COLUMNS so
+# the same table serves both the human queue and this tool). The revision-tracking columns
+# are appended after the human columns and are read only by this tool.
+DECISION_COLUMNS = [
+    "来源",
+    "待决问题",
+    "现状核验",
+    "推荐",
+    "关闭条件",
+    "优先级",
+    "影响范围",
+    "自动决策",
+]
+
+DEC_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^DEC-(\d{4})-(\d{3})$")
+REV_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"^r(\d+)$")
+REV_INLINE_RE = re.compile(r"(\d+)")
+DIGEST_RE = re.compile(r"<!--\s*decision-index-digest:\s*([0-9a-f]{64})\s*-->")
+
+# decision_deps frontmatter token forms (flat, inline-list so the gate's flat frontmatter
+# parser accepts them without a nested-mapping error):
+#   DEC-YYYY-NNN#rN                       pin a revision
+#   DEC-YYYY-NNN#invariant=<text>         pin an invariant (text must still appear)
+#   DEC-YYYY-NNN#rN#stale_reason=<...>#review_date=YYYY-MM-DD   tolerated stale pin
+DEP_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"^(DEC-\d{4}-\d{3})#(.+)$")
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# Ledger parsing
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+def _split_row(line: str) -> list[str]:
+    """Split a Markdown table row into cells (outer pipes optional, trimmed)."""
+    text = line.strip().removeprefix("|").removesuffix("|")
+    return [cell.strip() for cell in text.split("|")]
+
+
+def _is_separator(cells: list[str]) -> bool:
+    return all(set(cell) <= {"-", ":", " "} and cell for cell in cells)
+
+
+def parse_ledger(text: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Parse the decision-record table in ``docs/PENDING-DECISIONS.md``.
+
+    Returns ``{decision_id: record}`` where each record has: rev (int), withdrawn (set[int]),
+    equivalent_to (set[int]), terminal (str), status (str), text (str), row (dict[str,str]).
+    Only rows whose ``#`` (or ``DEC编号``) cell matches ``DEC-YYYY-NNN`` enter the ledger.
+    """
+    records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    lines = text.splitlines()
+    header: dict[str, int] | None = None
+    for raw in lines:
+        if not raw.strip().startswith("|"):
+            continue
+        cells = _split_row(raw)
+        if header is None:
+            # Identify the decision-record table by its columns.
+            if all(col in cells for col in DECISION_COLUMNS):
+                header = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(cells) if name}
+            continue
+        if _is_separator(cells):
+            continue
+        id_col = header.get("DEC编号", header.get("#", -1))
+        if id_col is None or id_col < 0 or id_col >= len(cells):
+            continue
+        dec_id = cells[id_col].strip()
+        if not DEC_ID_RE.match(dec_id):
+            continue
+        row = {name: (cells[i] if i < len(cells) else "") for name, i in header.items()}
+
+        def _rev_value(name: str, row: dict[str, str] = row) -> int:
+            raw_val = row.get(name, "").strip()
+            if not raw_val:
+                return 0
+            m = REV_TOKEN_RE.match(raw_val)
+            if m:
+                return int(m.group(1))
+            m = REV_INLINE_RE.search(raw_val)
+            return int(m.group(1)) if m else 0
+
+        def _rev_set(name: str, row: dict[str, str] = row) -> set[int]:
+            raw_val = row.get(name, "").strip()
+            out: set[int] = set()
+            for tok in re.split(r"[,\s]+", raw_val):
+                tok = tok.strip()
+                if not tok:
+                    continue
+                m = REV_TOKEN_RE.match(tok)
+                if m:
+                    out.add(int(m.group(1)))
+                else:
+                    m = REV_INLINE_RE.search(tok)
+                    if m:
+                        out.add(int(m.group(1)))
+            return out
+
+        terminal = row.get("终态", "").strip().lower()
+        terminal_known = not terminal or terminal in ("superseded", "withdrawn", "deferred")
+        records[dec_id] = {
+            "id": dec_id,
+            "rev": _rev_value("修订") or 1,
+            "withdrawn": _rev_set("撤回"),
+            "equivalent_to": _rev_set("等价"),
+            "terminal": terminal,
+            "terminal_known": terminal_known,
+            "status": row.get("状态", "").strip(),
+            "text": " ".join(row.values()),
+            "row": row,
+        }
+    return records
+
+
+def load_ledger(root: Path = ROOT) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    path = root / "docs" / "PENDING-DECISIONS.md"
+    if not path.is_file():
+        return {}
+    return parse_ledger(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# decision_deps parsing (downstream frontmatter)
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+def parse_dep_token(token: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Parse one ``decision_deps`` token into a structured dependency."""
+    m = DEP_TOKEN_RE.match(token.strip())
+    if not m:
+        return {"raw": token.strip(), "valid": False}
+    dec_id, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2)
+    dep: dict[str, Any] = {"id": dec_id, "valid": True}
+    # Split the rest on '#' so an invariant or stale metadata can follow.
+    parts = rest.split("#")
+    primary = parts[0]
+    rev_m = REV_TOKEN_RE.match(primary)
+    if rev_m:
+        dep["rev"] = int(rev_m.group(1))
+    elif primary.startswith("invariant="):
+        invariant = primary[len("invariant="):]
+        if not invariant.strip():
+            return {"raw": token.strip(), "valid": False, "reason": "不变式为空"}
+        dep["invariant"] = invariant
+    for part in parts[1:]:
+        if part.startswith("stale_reason="):
+            dep["stale_reason"] = part[len("stale_reason="):]
+        elif part.startswith("review_date="):
+            dep["review_date"] = part[len("review_date="):]
+    return dep
+
+
+def extract_decision_deps(frontmatter: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Read ``decision_deps`` from a parsed frontmatter mapping.
+
+    Accepts the inline-list string form (``[a, b]``) produced by the gate's flat parser.
+    """
+    raw = frontmatter.get("decision_deps")
+    if raw is None:
+        return []
+    if isinstance(raw, str):
+        # inline list already split by the gate parser may arrive as a single string of
+        # comma-separated tokens; split defensively.
+        tokens = [t.strip() for t in raw.strip("[]").split(",") if t.strip()]
+    elif isinstance(raw, list):
+        tokens = [str(t).strip() for t in raw if str(t).strip()]
+    else:
+        return []
+    deps = [parse_dep_token(t) for t in tokens]
+    return deps
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# check
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+def _today() -> date:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).date()
+
+
+def _review_date_valid(review_date: str | None) -> bool:
+    if not review_date:
+        return False
+    try:
+        return datetime.strptime(review_date, "%Y-%m-%d").date() >= _today()
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+
+
+def evaluate_dep(dep: dict[str, Any], decision: dict[str, Any] | None) -> str | None:
+    """Return an error string if the dependency is stale/red, else None (green).
+
+    Implements G7-AC-02 (withdrawn revision → red), G7-AC-03 (equivalent_to → green),
+    G7-AC-04 (stale_reason + review_date → green; bare exempt → red), G7-AC-05
+    (invariant still present → green).
+    """
+    if not dep.get("valid"):
+        reason = dep.get("reason")
+        suffix = f"（{reason}）" if reason else ""
+        return f"decision_deps 含不可解析的条目 {dep.get('raw', '')!r}{suffix}"
+    dec_id = dep["id"]
+    if decision is None:
+        return f"依赖未立账的决策 {dec_id}（该 DEC 编号不存在于台账）"
+    if not decision.get("terminal_known", True):
+        return (
+            f"决策 {dec_id} 的终态词 {decision['terminal']!r} 无法识别"
+            "（须 superseded / withdrawn / deferred）"
+        )
+
+    # A terminal decision is dead even when the downstream pins its *current* revision or an
+    # invariant: the number stays citable, but it is no longer an actionable dependency. A
+    # registered stale_reason + future review date is the only tolerated exemption (G7-AC-04).
+    if decision["terminal"] in ("superseded", "withdrawn", "deferred"):
+        if dep.get("stale_reason") and _review_date_valid(dep.get("review_date")):
+            return None
+        return f"依赖 {dec_id} 但该决策已终态（{decision['terminal']}），须更新或登记豁免"
+
+    if dep.get("invariant") is not None:
+        if dep["invariant"] in decision["text"]:
+            return None
+        return f"依赖 {dec_id} 钉定的不变式「{dep['invariant']}」已不在决策正文中（当前修订 r{decision['rev']}）"
+
+    pinned = dep.get("rev")
+    if pinned is None:
+        return f"依赖 {dec_id} 既未钉定修订也未钉定不变式"
+    current = decision["rev"]
+    if pinned == current:
+        if pinned in decision["withdrawn"]:
+            return f"依赖 {dec_id} 钉定 r{pinned}，但该修订已被撤回（当前 r{current}）"
+        return None
+    if pinned > current:
+        return f"依赖 {dec_id} 钉定了不存在的修订 r{pinned}（当前仅到 r{current}）"
+    # pinned < current
+    # Exemption override (G7-AC-04): a registered stale_reason + still-valid review date
+    # keeps any lagging pin green — including a withdrawn-revision pin. Without it the pin is
+    # judged on its own merits below: `#exempt=true` is not a legal token and is ignored.
+    if dep.get("stale_reason") and _review_date_valid(dep.get("review_date")):
+        return None  # tolerated stale pin
+    if pinned in decision["withdrawn"]:
+        return (
+            f"依赖 {dec_id} 钉定 r{pinned}，但该修订已被撤回（当前 r{current}）"
+            f"——须更新钉定或登记 stale_reason + 复核日期"
+        )
+    if pinned in decision["equivalent_to"]:
+        return None  # current revision is equivalent to the pinned one (G7-AC-03)
+    return (
+        f"依赖 {dec_id} 钉定 r{pinned} 已过期（当前 r{current}，且既非撤回等价也非已登记豁免）"
+    )
+
+
+def check(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[str]:
+    """Scan the repo for ``decision_deps`` and report only truly affected documents."""
+    ledger = load_ledger(root)
+    ledger_path = root / "docs" / "PENDING-DECISIONS.md"
+    errors: list[str] = []
+    if ledger_path.is_file():
+        for line in ledger_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+            if line.lstrip().startswith("|") and "DEC编号" in line:
+                for column in ("DEC编号", "修订", "撤回", "等价", "终态"):
+                    if column not in line:
+                        errors.append(f"台账表头缺列 {column!r}（parse_ledger 会静默用默认修订）")
+                break
+    # Append-only ledger: an id that was issued once must remain citable. issued.txt is the
+    # machine-side witness; deleting a row from the Markdown ledger is then a red, not a
+    # silent loss (P2-3).
+    issued_path = root / "docs" / "decisions" / "issued.txt"
+    if issued_path.is_file():
+        for line in issued_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+            dec_id = line.strip()
+            if not dec_id or dec_id.startswith("#"):
+                continue
+            if dec_id not in ledger:
+                errors.append(f"已发放编号 {dec_id} 从台账消失（issued.txt 只追加，不得移除）")
+    ledger_text = ledger_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if ledger_path.is_file() else ""
+    if "DEC-" in ledger_text and not ledger:
+        errors.append("台账含 DEC 编号但解析为 0 条（表头缺失或格式无法识别）")
+    if "DEC-" in ledger_text and not issued_path.is_file():
+        errors.append("台账含 DEC 编号但 docs/decisions/issued.txt 缺失（发放见证不可省）")
+    if issued_path.is_file():
+        issued_ids = {
+            line.strip()
+            for line in issued_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
+            if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith("#")
+        }
+        for dec_id in ledger:
+            if dec_id not in issued_ids:
+                errors.append(f"台账编号 {dec_id} 未登记进 issued.txt（新编号须追加见证）")
+    # Walk Markdown documents; the ledger file itself carries no decision_deps.
+    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*.md")):
+        if path.resolve() == ledger_path.resolve():
+            continue
+        relative_parts = path.relative_to(root).parts
+        if "packaging" in relative_parts and "runtime" in relative_parts:
+            continue  # generated byte-for-byte copy; the source document is the authority
+        if any(part.startswith(".") for part in relative_parts):
+            continue  # .git / .venv / .workbuddy-ai and other hidden tool directories
+        rel = path.relative_to(root)
+        try:
+            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
+            continue
+        if "decision_deps" not in text:
+            continue
+        fm = _parse_flat_frontmatter(text)
+        deps = extract_decision_deps(fm)
+        if "decision_deps" in fm and not deps:
+            errors.append(
+                f"{rel}: decision_deps 存在但解析不出任何条目"
+                "（须为行内列表，合法形态 DEC-YYYY-NNN#rN 或 #invariant=原文）"
+            )
+            continue
+        if not deps:
+            continue
+        for dep in deps:
+            verdict = evaluate_dep(dep, ledger.get(dep.get("id", "")))
+            if verdict:
+                errors.append(f"{rel}: {verdict}")
+    return errors
+
+
+def _parse_flat_frontmatter(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Minimal frontmatter reader that tolerates the flat ``decision_deps`` inline list.
+
+    The gate's own parser rejects nested mapping lines; downstream docs therefore encode
+    decision_deps as a flat inline list (no nested objects), which this reader handles. We
+    keep this local so we never depend on the gate's stricter parser for the dependency scan.
+    """
+    lines = text.splitlines()
+    if not lines or lines[0].strip() != "---":
+        return {}
+    try:
+        end = next(i for i in range(1, len(lines)) if lines[i].strip() == "---")
+    except StopIteration:
+        return {}
+    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    list_key: str | None = None
+    for raw in lines[1:end]:
+        line = raw.rstrip()
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        if line.startswith("  - "):
+            if list_key:
+                data[list_key].append(line[4:].strip())
+            continue
+        if ":" not in line:
+            continue
+        key, _, value = line.partition(":")
+        key = key.strip()
+        value = value.strip()
+        if not key:
+            continue
+        if value == "":
+            data[key] = []
+            list_key = key
+        else:
+            list_key = None
+            if value.startswith("[") and value.endswith("]"):
+                inner = value[1:-1].strip()
+                data[key] = [t.strip() for t in inner.split(",") if t.strip()]
+            else:
+                if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in "'\"":
+                    value = value[1:-1]
+                data[key] = value
+    return data
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# view
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+def view(root: Path = ROOT) -> str:
+    """Render the pending view: decisions that are still active (no terminal state)."""
+    ledger = load_ledger(root)
+    active = [
+        rec
+        for rec in ledger.values()
+        if not rec["terminal"]
+    ]
+    active.sort(key=lambda r: r["id"])
+    out: list[str] = []
+    out.append("# 决策待办视图（由 decisions.py view 生成，禁止手改）")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append("> 本视图只列出尚未进入终态（superseded / withdrawn / deferred）的决策；")
+    out.append("> 终态条目保留在台账 `docs/PENDING-DECISIONS.md` 中，按「只追加、永不移出」规则不移除。")
+    out.append("")
+    if not active:
+        out.append("_当前无未决决策。_")
+        out.append("")
+        return "\n".join(out)
+    out.append("| DEC 编号 | 修订 | 状态 | 待决问题（摘要） |")
+    out.append("| --- | --- | --- | --- |")
+    for rec in active:
+        problem = rec["row"].get("待决问题", "").replace("\n", " ")
+        problem = (problem[:40] + "…") if len(problem) > 41 else problem
+        out.append(f"| {rec['id']} | r{rec['rev']} | {rec['status']} | {problem} |")
+    out.append("")
+    return "\n".join(out)
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# index (generated file with digest)
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+def render_index_body(root: Path = ROOT) -> str:
+    ledger = load_ledger(root)
+    out: list[str] = []
+    out.append("# 决策台账索引（由 decisions.py index --write 生成，禁止手改）")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append("> 生成文件。任何手工修改都会使摘要校验失败（门随即转红）。重新生成：")
+    out.append("> `python3 tools/lab/decisions.py index --write`。")
+    out.append("")
+    out.append("| DEC 编号 | 当前修订 | 终态 | 撤回 | 等价 | 状态 |")
+    out.append("| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |")
+    for dec_id in sorted(ledger):
+        rec = ledger[dec_id]
+        withdrawn = ",".join(f"r{r}" for r in sorted(rec["withdrawn"])) or "—"
+        equiv = ",".join(f"r{r}" for r in sorted(rec["equivalent_to"])) or "—"
+        out.append(
+            f"| {dec_id} | r{rec['rev']} | {rec['terminal'] or '—'} | {withdrawn} | {equiv} | {rec['status']} |"
+        )
+    out.append("")
+    return "\n".join(out)
+
+
+def render_index(root: Path = ROOT) -> str:
+    """Full index content including the digest footer (deterministic)."""
+    body = render_index_body(root)
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(body.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+    return f"{body}<!-- decision-index-digest: {digest} -->\n"
+
+
+def write_index(root: Path = ROOT) -> Path:
+    path = DECISIONS_INDEX if root == ROOT else root / "docs" / "decisions" / "index.md"
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(render_index(root), encoding="utf-8")
+    return path
+
+
+def verify_index(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[str]:
+    """Validate the committed index.md against what the generator would produce."""
+    path = DECISIONS_INDEX if root == ROOT else root / "docs" / "decisions" / "index.md"
+    if not path.is_file():
+        return [f"{path.relative_to(root)}: 决策索引缺失（运行 decisions.py index --write 生成）"]
+    content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    canonical = render_index(root)
+    if content != canonical:
+        return [
+            (
+                f"{path.relative_to(root)}: 决策索引是生成文件，禁止手改——内容与生成器不符"
+                f"（运行 decisions.py index --write 重新生成）"
+            )
+        ]
+    return []
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+# CLI
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    args = argv if argv is not None else sys.argv[1:]
+    command = args[0] if args else "check"
+    rest = args[1:]
+
+    root = ROOT
+    if "--root" in rest:
+        idx = rest.index("--root")
+        root = Path(rest[idx + 1]).resolve()
+        rest = rest[:idx] + rest[idx + 2:]
+
+    if command == "view":
+        sys.stdout.write(view(root))
+        sys.stdout.write("\n")
+        return 0
+    if command == "check":
+        errors = check(root)
+        if errors:
+            for e in errors:
+                print(f"STALE {e}")
+            return 1
+        print("OK decisions: 无过期决策依赖")
+        return 0
+    if command == "index":
+        if "--write" in rest:
+            path = write_index(root)
+            print(f"wrote {path.relative_to(root)}")
+            return 0
+        if "--verify" in rest:
+            errors = verify_index(root)
+            for e in errors:
+                print(f"FAIL {e}")
+            return 1 if errors else 0
+        # default: print canonical content to stdout (used by the gate compare)
+        sys.stdout.write(render_index(root))
+        return 0
+    print(f"unknown command: {command}", file=sys.stderr)
+    return 2
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+def is_separator_row(line: str) -> bool:
+    """A table separator row. The leading/trailing pipe is optional (CommonMark)."""
+    return bool(SEP_RE.match(line))

+def is_table_row(line: str) -> bool:
+    """A pipe-table row: carries a pipe, is not a fence, and is not a separator.
+
+    CommonMark does not require the leading or trailing pipe, so a table written as
+    `ID | 任务 | 状态` (no outer pipes) must be read the same as `| ID | 任务 | 状态 |`.
+    Reading only pipe-wrapped rows made the two gate families disagree on the same file
+    (2026-10-25 提案 §2.2 L3), which is why this predicate lives in one place now.
+    """
+    s = line.strip()
+    if not s or "|" not in s:
+        return False
+    if s.startswith(("```", "~~~")):
+        return False
+    return not is_separator_row(s)
+

+def column_index(header: list[str], name: str) -> int | None:
+    """Position of `name` in a header row, or None. Cells may carry `**` / backticks."""
+    for position, cell in enumerate(header):
+        if cell.strip().strip("`*_ ").strip() == name:
+            return position
+    return None

+def decision_marker_presence_findings(repo_root: Path) -> list[str]:

+ASSERTION_CLASS_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]+(?:Tests?|Cases?)$")
+ASSERTION_FUNC_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\(\)$")
+ASSERTION_FILE_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*\.(?:py|md|json|sh|txt|ya?ml)$")
+_GENERATED_PARTS = {".git", ".venv", "node_modules", "__pycache__"}
+

+@lru_cache(maxsize=8)
+def _repo_code_text(root: str) -> str:
+    """Source text used to resolve class/function assertions (tests/ and tools/ only).
+
+    Docs are deliberately excluded: a plan that merely discusses a ghost test class must not
+    make that class "resolve" and hide the very gap this layer exists to catch.
+    """
+    parts: list[str] = []
+    root_path = Path(root)
+    for top in ("tests", "tools"):
+        base = root_path / top
+        if not base.is_dir():
+            continue
+        for path in base.rglob("*.py"):
+            if any(part in _GENERATED_PARTS for part in path.parts):
+                continue
+            try:
+                parts.append(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"))
+            except OSError:
+                continue
+    return "\n".join(parts)
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=8)
+def _repo_file_names(root: str) -> frozenset[str]:
+    names: set[str] = set()
+    root_path = Path(root)
+    for path in root_path.rglob("*"):
+        if not path.is_file():
+            continue
+        if any(part in _GENERATED_PARTS for part in path.parts):
+            continue
+        if "packaging/runtime" in path.as_posix():
+            continue
+        names.add(path.name)
+    return frozenset(names)
+

+def assertion_resolvability_findings(
+    label: str, task_id: str, evidence: str, repo_root: Path
+) -> list[str]:
+    """C23 assertion layer (T17): code/file assertions in evidence must resolve in the repo.
+
+    An evidence cell can carry a real path *and* a fabricated class/function/file name; the
+    carrier check alone would accept the row. This layer only inspects tokens shaped like a
+    test-class name, a `name()` call, or a bare filename, so prose and command output are
+    untouched (no false positives from ordinary quotations).
+    """
+    errors: list[str] = []
+    # A row that explicitly marks the carrier as N/A or historical is not making a positive
+    # "this still exists" claim; the removed-object exemption must not be re-red by T17.
+    if NA_RE.search(evidence) or any(word in evidence for word in ("已随", "已失", "不复存在", "已删除")):
+        return errors
+    code_text = _repo_code_text(str(repo_root))
+    file_names = _repo_file_names(str(repo_root))
+    for span in re.findall(r"`([^`\n]+)`", evidence):
+        token = span.strip()
+        if not token or "/" in token or "@" in token or ":" in token:
+            continue
+        if ASSERTION_FUNC_RE.match(token):
+            name = token[:-2]
+            if name not in code_text:
+                errors.append(
+                    f"C23 断言可解析: {label} {task_id} 的断言 {token} 在仓内代码中不可解析"
+                )
+        elif ASSERTION_CLASS_RE.match(token) and token not in code_text:
+            errors.append(
+                f"C23 断言可解析: {label} {task_id} 的断言 {token} 在仓内代码中不可解析"
+            )
+        elif ASSERTION_FILE_RE.match(token) and token not in file_names:
+            errors.append(
+                f"C23 断言可解析: {label} {task_id} 的断言 {token} 在仓内不存在"
+            )
+    return errors

+# T16: a correction statement in a changelog/issue record must be propagated to every other
+# reference, otherwise a reader can still follow the retracted claim. The scan is deliberately
+# narrow: only code-shaped identifiers (test classes, filenames) are traced, so ordinary prose
+# corrections do not turn into a repo-wide false-positive machine.
+CORRECTION_WORDS = ("从未进入", "不实", "勘误", "证伪")
+CORRECTION_MARKERS = CORRECTION_WORDS + ("更正", "已删除", "幽灵", "不存在", "retracted", "erratum")
+# Trace test-class names only. File names in a long changelog entry would flood every
+# still-in-use script; file/function assertions are covered by C23's resolvability layer.
+CORRECTION_IDENTIFIER_RE = re.compile(r"`([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:Tests?|Cases?))`")
+
+
+def _correction_sources(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
+    sources = [root / "CHANGELOG.md", root / "docs" / "changelog-archive.md"]
+    for base in (root / "docs" / "issues", root / "reviews", root / "docs" / "evaluations"):
+        if base.is_dir():
+            sources.extend(sorted(base.rglob("*.md")))
+    features = root / "docs" / "features"
+    if features.is_dir():
+        sources.extend(sorted(path for path in features.rglob("*.md") if path.parent.name == "reviews"))
+    return [path for path in sources if path.is_file()]
+
+
+def _reference_surface(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
+    files: list[Path] = []
+    for base in (root / "docs", root / "reviews", root / "agents", root / "skills", root / "episodes"):
+        if base.is_dir():
+            files.extend(sorted(base.rglob("*.md")))
+    for name in ("README.md", "AGENTS.md", "CHANGELOG.md", "docs/changelog-archive.md", "index.md"):
+        path = root / name
+        if path.is_file():
+            files.append(path)
+    return [
+        path for path in files
+        if "packaging/runtime" not in path.as_posix() and ".git" not in path.parts
+    ]
+
+
+def correction_propagation_findings(root: Path) -> list[ValidationError]:
+    errors: list[ValidationError] = []
+    corrections: dict[str, Path] = {}
+    for source in _correction_sources(root):
+        text, read_errors = read_document_text(source)
+        if read_errors:
+            errors.extend(read_errors)
+            continue
+        for line in text.splitlines():
+            if not any(word in line for word in CORRECTION_WORDS):
+                continue
+            for identifier in CORRECTION_IDENTIFIER_RE.findall(line):
+                corrections.setdefault(identifier, source)
+    if not corrections:
+        return errors
+    reported: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
+    for path in _reference_surface(root):
+        text, read_errors = read_document_text(path)
+        if read_errors:
+            errors.extend(read_errors)
+            continue
+        for line in text.splitlines():
+            for identifier, source in corrections.items():
+                if identifier not in line or path == source:
+                    continue
+                if any(marker in line for marker in CORRECTION_MARKERS) or re.search(r"N/A\s*[:：]", line):
+                    continue
+                key = (identifier, str(path))
+                if key in reported:
+                    continue
+                reported.add(key)
+                errors.append(
+                    ValidationError(
+                        str(path),
+                        f"更正追平: {identifier!r} 已在 {source.name} 被标注为更正/勘误，"
+                        "此处引用未带勘误标注",
+                    )
+                )
+    return errors

+# T12: a role file that tells the worker to produce schema-required fields or fixed sections
+# must name the same contract the gate enforces. Otherwise the role can be followed literally
+# and still be rejected ("按角色文件字面产出被门拒").

+def role_contract_findings(
+    path: Path,
+    text: str,
+    required_fields: list[str],
+    required_headings: tuple[str, ...],
+) -> list[ValidationError]:
+    errors: list[ValidationError] = []
+    for field in required_fields:
+        if field not in text:
+            errors.append(
+                ValidationError(str(path), f"schema-required field {field!r} is not named by the role file")
+            )
+    for heading in required_headings:
+        if heading not in text:
+            errors.append(
+                ValidationError(str(path), f"gate-required heading {heading!r} is not named by the role file")
+            )
+    return errors

+def validate_count_markers(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[ValidationError]:
+    """Wire the `<!-- count:… -->` markers into the gate (counts.py was outside every gate).
+
+    counts.py (the marker reader/writer) was the only checker in the repository not reachable
+    from `validate.py all`, CI, or any hook: adding a role file without remembering to run it
+    left README's「14 个角色档案」wrong with nothing turning red — the exact drift this tool
+    was built to kill. The counting logic itself stays in counts.py (single source); this
+    wrapper only imports it and translates a nonzero exit into gate errors. The import is
+    local because counts.py is a top-level module next to tools/lab, not a gate subpackage.
+    """
+    import subprocess as _subprocess
+    import sys as _sys
+
+    errors: list[ValidationError] = []
+    completed = _subprocess.run(
+        [_sys.executable, str(root / "tools" / "lab" / "counts.py")],
+        cwd=str(root),
+        text=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        timeout=120,
+        check=False,
+        env={**os.environ, "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"},
+    )
+    if completed.returncode == 0:
+        return errors
+    for line in (completed.stdout + completed.stderr).splitlines():
+        line = line.strip()
+        if line.startswith(("ERROR", "DIFF")):
+            errors.append(ValidationError("counts", line))
+    if not errors:
+        errors.append(
+            ValidationError(
+                "counts",
+                f"counts.py exited {completed.returncode} with no parseable findings: "
+                f"{(completed.stdout + completed.stderr).strip()[:200]}",
+            )
+        )
+    return errors
+

+BLOCKING_YES = ("是", "阻塞", "blocking", "yes")
+BLOCKING_NO = ("否", "不阻塞", "非阻塞", "no")

+def _blocking_cell(cells: list[str], columns: dict[str, int] | None) -> bool:
+    """Whether a 未决项 row is blocking, read from the blocking column by name (T07)."""
+    name = None
+    if columns:
+        for candidate in ("是否阻塞", "阻塞性", "是否阻塞实施", "阻塞"):
+            if candidate in columns:
+                name = candidate
+                break
+    if name is None or columns is None:
+        # The official three-column form (前置 / 关联任务 / 说明) has no blocking column: its rows
+        # are pending prerequisites, so they block approval until a closure marker appears.
+        return len(cells) <= 3
+    position = columns[name]
+    if position >= len(cells):
+        return True
+    value = cells[position].strip().strip("`* ")
+    if not value:
+        return True  # an empty blocking cell is not a "no"
+    if any(token in value for token in BLOCKING_NO):
+        return False
+    if any(token in value for token in BLOCKING_YES):
+        return True
+    # Fail closed: an unrecognised value (待定 / TBD / 未确认) is not evidence that the item
+    # may proceed; treating it as "no" let an approved plan carry an open blocker (F2).
+    return True

+def review_debt_report(root=ROOT) -> list[str]:
+    """Print the derived review-debt set (G2-AC-01), never a hand-maintained table.
+
+    ① a batch whose README/plan declares L0 but has no review record; ② an issue still
+    fixed-pending-review without a reviewer. The manual todo mirror is checked as a subset
+    by the spec, not used as the source.
+    """
+    lines: list[str] = []
+    features = root / "docs" / "features"
+    if features.is_dir():
+        for batch in sorted(path for path in features.iterdir() if path.is_dir()):
+            texts: list[str] = []
+            readme = batch / "README.md"
+            if readme.is_file():
+                texts.append(readme.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"))
+            plan_dir = batch / "plan"
+            if plan_dir.is_dir():
+                texts.extend(
+                    path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+                    for path in sorted(plan_dir.glob("*.md"))
+                )
+            blob = "\n".join(texts)
+            if not re.search(r"review_tier\s*[:：]\s*L0|评审档位[^\n]*\bL0\b", blob):
+                continue
+            reviews = batch / "reviews"
+            has_record = False
+            if reviews.is_dir():
+                for candidate in reviews.rglob("*.md"):
+                    if not candidate.is_file() or candidate.name == "README.md":
+                        continue
+                    frontmatter, _, read_errors = load_record_markdown(candidate)
+                    if not read_errors and frontmatter and (
+                        frontmatter.get("review_id") or frontmatter.get("review_tier")
+                    ):
+                        has_record = True
+                        break
+            if not has_record:
+                lines.append(f"batch: {batch.relative_to(root).as_posix()}")
+    issues = root / "docs" / "issues"
+    if issues.is_dir():
+        for path in sorted(issues.glob("ISS-*.md")):
+            frontmatter, _, read_errors = load_record_markdown(path)
+            if read_errors or not frontmatter:
+                continue
+            if frontmatter.get("status") == "fixed-pending-review" and not frontmatter.get("reviewer"):
+                lines.append(f"issue: {path.stem}")
+    return lines
+

+def _cell(cells: list[str], columns: dict[str, int] | None, name: str, fallback: int) -> str:
+    """Read a cell by column name; fall back to a position only when the table has no header.

+def _int_version(value: Any) -> int | None:
+    """A record version as an int; YAML hands back `2`, `"2"`, or a non-numeric string."""
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        text = value.strip().strip("\"'")
+        if text.isdigit():
+            return int(text)
+    return None

+def _count_files(base: Path, suffix: str) -> int:
+    if not base.is_dir():
+        return 0
+    return sum(
+        1
+        for path in base.rglob(f"*{suffix}")
+        if path.is_file() and "packaging/runtime" not in path.as_posix()

+def _scan_count(label: str) -> int | None:
+    """Objects the check actually walks, printed next to PASS (T03)."""
+    if label == "schemas":
+        return _count_files(ROOT / "schemas", ".schema.json")
+    if label == "examples":
+        return _count_files(ROOT / "examples", "")
+    if label == "artifacts":
+        return sum(
+            _count_files(ROOT / name, ".md") + _count_files(ROOT / name, ".json")
+            for name in LIVE_RECORD_ROOTS
+        )
+    if label == "protected":
+        path = Path(PROTECTED_PATHS_FILE)
